headline: Email drafts wait for your click, and a quiet contact is checked against live mail before anyone says so.

items.prompt_template: Drafting an email now shows you the card first and writes the draft only when you choose. Before anyone is flagged as going quiet, I check recent mail and calendar activity. The commitments card stays small enough to arrive every time, a name that could be two people asks you which one, and the morning brief drops an item once you have replied.
